data.name: Version 2026.10.0
data.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 8092e6a33f8ff636410469f822297a645dd27e47 -->

## What's Changed
- Added support for sharing vault items through temporary links
- Added a setting to configure access token lifetime
- Fixed switching to annual billing during a trial charging an extra month
- Various under-the-hood improvements and minor bug fixes

### :shipit: Feature Development
* [PM-40416] feat: Add Premium to organization upgrade invoice preview endpoint by @cyprain-okeke in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8322
* [PM-44001] Add pm-43231-access-intelligence-performance-at-scale feature flag by @Banrion in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8419
* [PM-43031] Add email verification check to confirm-invite endpoint by @JimmyVo16 in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8418
* Add ability to override access token lifetime by @trmartin4 in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8367
* [PM-40097] feat: add PamSeats and MaxAutoscalePamSeats columns to Organization by @amorask-bitwarden in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8405
* [PFI-1300] Add SCIM 2.0 discovery endpoints by @fer in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8430
* [PM-42836] feat: Return the sponsoring organization name from sponsorship token pre-validation by @cyprain-okeke in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8403
* [PM-39106] refactor: Remove pm-34423-staged-status feature flag by @sven-bitwarden in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8402
* [PAM-185] Access Leasing: derive status from stored facts by @Hinton in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8411
* [PM-40420] feat: add account subscription preview endpoint by @amorask-bitwarden in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8435
* Auth/PM-41569 - New Device Verification Cache Improvement by @JaredSnider-Bitwarden in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8353
* [PM-44094] feat: Make the dead letter sweep interval configurable by @withinfocus in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8401
* [PAM-186] Access Requests: API by @Hinton in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8448
* [PM-44131] Remove feature check on bulk folder delete by @trmartin4 in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8460
* [PAM-187] Access Leasing: API by @Hinton in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8461
* [PM-40412] feat: Add Premium and organization purchase invoice preview endpoints by @cyprain-okeke in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8453
* Add Windows Native Credential Sync feature flag by @iinuwa in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8479
* [PM-43032] Add PreAccessPolicyEnforce by @JimmyVo16 in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8437
* Add the PAM access-audit event store by @patriksvensson in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8230
* [PM-42434] Account for staged users in confirm endpoint by @JimmyVo16 in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8447
* [BRE-1175] Allow choosing the Teams channel per event configuration by @vgrassia in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8480
* [PM-44349] Add force-upgrade-v2-encryption feature flag by @mzieniukbw in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8492
* [PM-44202] feat: Store item id in Item Send metadata by @quexten in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8485
* [PM-43938] Collection endpoint for Access Intelligence Needs by @Banrion in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8425
* [PM-44303] Add emergency access SDK API flag by @quexten in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8493
* [PM-43785] Login only organization cipher fetch for Access Intelligence by @Banrion in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8443
* [PM-41284] feat: Mark Stripe subscription schedules with their managing system by @kdenney in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8478
* [PAM-188] Cipher Leases: API and commercial gate by @Hinton in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8494
### 🐛 Bug fixes
* [PM-42488] fix: Treat a blank account recovery key as a withdrawal by @r-tome in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8356
* [PM-43897] fix: set Reply-To on price migration email by @connerbw in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8386
* [PM-42473] Use SSRF protected HttpClient in Teams service, block Teams/Slack integrations from API updates by @lastbestdev in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8334
* PM-43809: bugfix: Retain attachments in default collection (My Items) when purging org vault by @nikwithak in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8387
* [PM-16095] Fix up messages for Teams error messages for seat counts by @JaredScar in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8406
* [PM-43335] VFO1 Terminology name changes to utilize with error toasts by @JaredScar in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8417
* [PM-42560] fix: Gate billing exception detail behind IsDevelopment by @connerbw in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8348
* [PM-42560] fix: Stop disclosing exception detail from licensed SSO errors by @connerbw in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8358
* [PM-43757] clean up SSO user rows on bulk delete by @BTreston in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8412
* [PM-43790] Fix collection access validation to reject invalid Manage/ReadOnly combinations by @JimmyVo16 in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8413
* [PM-35064] fix: Scope EF Core collection removal to caller's available collections by @gbubemismith in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8441
* Fix flaky access-rule RevisionDate test on SqlServer by @Hinton in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8444
* [PM-43336] - Fix Invite Default Collection Assignment by @jrmccannon in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8420
* [BRE-1175] Fix Teams integration tenant by @vgrassia in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8452
* [BRE-1175] Fix API base URL for Slack and Teams integration by @vgrassia in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8449
* Seeder/fix deployed cloud licensing error on single user scene by @nthompson-bitwarden in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8451
* [PM-43763] Fix SCIM group patch parsing guids by @BTreston in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8455
* [PM-42982] fix: WantAssertionsSigned throws on encrypted assertion by @enmande in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8381
* [BRE-1175] Fix Teams integration handler error handling by @vgrassia in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8473
* Seeder/fix flaky integration tests from self-hosted data protection path by @nthompson-bitwarden in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8486
* [PM-43029] fix: apply Restrict item deletion policy to attachment paths by @jaasen-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8422
* Cherry-pick: [PM-44448] fix: Keep the trial when redeeming the annual upgrade offer by @kdenney in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8528
* [PM-44658] fix: Send and apply U2F AppID for migrated WebAuthn 2FA keys (#8554) by @enmande in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8555
### ⚙️ Maintenance
* [CL-1059] Remove router focus flag by @vleague2 in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8414
* [PM-30484] [PM-28140] Remove pm-2035-passkey-unlock and pm-26340-linux-biometrics-v2 feature flags by @jlf0dev in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8423
* Bump version to 2026.9.2 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8454

* Delete deprecated EF Integration tests - Vault by @eliykat in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8475
* [PM-19945] chore: Remove PM19941MigrateCipherDomainToSdk feature flag by @nick-livefront in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8464
* Delete deprecated EF Integration tests - DIRT by @eliykat in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8476

* Bump version to 2026.10.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/bitwarden/server/pull/8505
### 📦 Dependency Updates
